name: Huri
title: Descendant of Gad
summary: Huri is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles as part of the genealogy of the tribe of Gad. He was the father of Abihail and belonged to one of the families living in Gilead in Bashan. He is primarily known through genealogical lists and has no independent narrative in the Bible.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Gad's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Huri is listed in the genealogy of the tribe of Gad as the son of Jaroah and the father of Abihail.

keyEvents.title: The tribe of Gad in Gilead
keyEvents.description: Gad's descendants, including Huri's lineage, lived in Gilead in Bashan and in the surrounding areas.

keyEvents.title: Genealogical registration during Jotham and Jeroboam
keyEvents.description: The genealogies of the tribe of Gad, to which Huri belonged, were recorded during the days of Jotham king of Judah and Jeroboam king of Israel.

keyEvents.title: Warrior Men of the Tribe of Gad
keyEvents.description: The tribe of Gad, of which Hur's descendants were a part, had skilled warriors who carried shields and swords and drew the bow.
